title: Jomi Drops his latest track titled, “CARDONA”
htmlContent:
Hailing from Northern California, Jomi has proven himself to secure a place in the music scene. Jomi is a talented singer and songwriter who can demonstrate his artistry with the release of his recent track “CARDONA.”

Jomi “CARDONA” is about coming to terms with whatever fear lingers in your soul and building yourself up to confront it confidentially. The sound of this track is exhilarating, with high energy in the production that sets the ultimate tone to bring a swaggy vocal performance that is infectious and fun for every minute.
